subject: Online Assessment Invitation – Google SWE Internship
snippet: Please complete the HackerRank coding assessment within 72 hours.
body_preview:
Hi,

Congratulations on moving forward in the interview process for the Software Engineer Internship at Google!

As the next step, we'd like you to complete an online coding assessment hosted on HackerRank. Please complete it within 72 hours of receiving this email.

Assessment Link: https://hr.gs/google-swe-2026
Deadline: May 3, 2026 at 11:59 PM PST

The assessment will take approximately 90 minutes. You may use any programming language.

Good luck!
Google University Recruiting

subject: HackerRank Test – Meta Software Engineer
snippet: Meta has invited you to take a HackerRank test. Deadline: May 4, 2026.
body_preview:
Hello,

Meta has invited you to complete a coding assessment as part of the interview process for the Software Engineer role.

Test Link: https://www.hackerrank.com/test/meta-swe-2026

subject: Interview Invitation – Microsoft SWE
snippet: We'd like to schedule a technical interview. Please book a slot via Calendly.
body_preview:
Hi,

Congratulations! We'd like to invite you to a technical interview for the Software Engineer role at Microsoft.

Please schedule a 60-minute slot at your convenience using the link below:
https://calendly.com/microsoft-recruiting/swe-interview

Available slots: May 5–9, 2026

The interview will cover system design and coding problems.

Looking forward to speaking with you!
Microsoft University Recruiting

subject: Next Steps – Spotify Engineering Interview
snippet: We'd like to schedule your technical phone screen. Please share your availability.
body_preview:
Hello,

Thank you for your application to Spotify for the Backend Engineer role. We'd like to move forward with a technical phone screen.

Please reply to this email with your availability for a 45-minute call next week (May 4–8, 2026). We're in the CET timezone.

The call will cover:
- Your background and experience
- One or two coding problems

Looking forward to chatting!
Spotify Talent Acquisition

subject: Take-Home Assignment – Jane Street Quantitative Developer
snippet: Please complete the attached take-home coding assignment and return it within 5 days.
body_preview:
Hi,

Thank you for progressing in our interview process for the Quantitative Developer role.

Attached is a take-home coding assignment. Please complete it using OCaml, Python, or Java and return your solution via email within 5 days (by May 6, 2026).

The problem involves:
- Parsing a large dataset
- Implementing a custom algorithm
- Writing tests for your solution

Please treat this as a production-grade submission.

Good luck!
Jane Street Recruiting
